table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.Name,
	itemaliasname=item.Customicode,
	ItemPacking.Name, 
	Item.PackUnits,
	prledger.Prinvcode, 
	remarks=prledger.remarks,
	prledger.Date,
	Qty = prdetail.Looseqty + prdetail.Packqty,
	prdetail.Bonusqty,
	Rate=prdetail.PrPrice,
	dbo.prledger.suppcode,
	supplieraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,		
	dbo.accounts.name,		
	prdetail.discperc,
	invdiscperc=prledger.discperc,
	purtype=(select name from purchasetype where purtypecode=prledger.prtypecode),
	type=CASE WHEN prledger.prcatcode <= 5 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'OPENING' END,
	prdetail.batch,
	prdetail.expiry,
	SalesTax=
		(SELECT	SUM((PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +  
				Round( PD.PrPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
				(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +
				( Round((Round( Round(PD.PrPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
				(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01), 2) * (1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01), 2) - 
				PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 *  PL.invgstperc1 ,2) ) / CASE WHEN (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty) END)
		FROM prledger PL, prdetail PD
		WHERE PL.PrinvCode = PD.PrInvCode AND PD.prutn = prdetail.prutn),
	NetRate=(SELECT NETRATE=(PD.PrPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
								(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * ( 1 - PL.discperc * .01 ) + 
								(PD.unitsalestax * ( PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty )) +  
					Round( PD.PrPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * (1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01) * 0.01 * PD.gstperc, 2) +
						( Round((
							Round( 
								Round(PD.PrPrice * (PD.LooseQty + PD.PackQty) * 
									(1 - PD.DiscPerc * .01),2) * 
									(1 -  PL.discperc * 0.01),2) - PL.flatdisc) * 0.01 *  
									PL.invgstperc1 ,2)) ) /
								CASE WHEN (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (PD.Looseqty + PD.PackQty + PD.bonusqty) END
		FROM PrLedger PL, PRDetail PD
		WHERE PL.PrinvCode = PD.PrInvCode AND PD.prutn = prdetail.prutn),
	Posted=prledger.Posted,
	UserName=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=prledger.salesmancode)
FROM
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (Item.Packcode = ItemPacking.Packcode),
	prledger,
	accounts,
	prdetail

WHERE 
	(Item.icode = :ar_icode ) and
	( dbo.prdetail.icode = :ar_icode) and 
	(dbo.prdetail.Prinvcode=dbo.prledger.Prinvcode) and 
	(dbo.prledger.Suppcode=dbo.accounts.acccode)
			
ORDER BY
	date desc,
	prledger.Prinvcode,
	accounts.name,
	prdetail.batch,
	prdetail.expiry
